jira_summary: Schedule list loading and scroll lag caused by excessive initial rendering and clock-tick list-wide renders
jira_description_excerpt: The Schedule list loads and scrolls with noticeable lag. The dominant costs are synchronously rendering 75 EventCards at first paint and re-rendering every mounted card on each ten-second schedule-clock tick.
jira_ac_summary: Initial mount renders approximately visible rows, not 75.
Clock ticks update only cards whose live state changes.
Time to interactivity and scroll frame rate measurably improve on a mid-range Android device.
context_sources: GitHub-backed BFF-124 and BFF-128 spec conventions
